long_biography.plain_text:
SuperSport became the platform that transformed Danko Ćorić from a low-profile Croatian businessman into one of the country's prominent private investors. He took control of the betting company in 2001, served as director for seventeen years and oversaw its expansion across shops, online wagering and casino games. EMMA Capital bought his final 33 per cent stake in 2022.

The exit shifted his public business identity towards a broader collection of operating and investment vehicles. Croatian registry records show him leading or owning companies in hotel accommodation, residential construction, fund management, property, nautical services and renewable electricity, while retaining a governance role at SuperSport. His portfolio includes PND Strategija, Next Invest and solar-power ventures at Palinovec and Hodošan.

uncertainties: Inventory of the immutable owner input preceded mandatory Forbes-first and broader web research. No prior dossier existed. Only this assigned dossier is created; no cohort, catalogue, other dossier or live-system state is altered.

Identity is terminally resolved at 93 confidence. The source surname Corić omits the initial Croatian diacritic used consistently in official records for entrepreneur Danko Ćorić. Croatian nationality and residence, the distinctive Ružarija vessel name, wife Linda's Ružarija company and his ownership of Posejdon Nautika form a collision-resistant bundle, although no public source explicitly states that he owns the yacht.

A different Danko Ćorić is a University of Zagreb materials-science professor born in Zagreb in 1966. His academic records, ORCID profile and publications were excluded because they do not match the business, family-company or yacht context. A Dutch medical researcher named Danko Coric was also excluded.
Forbes-first searches using exact and unaccented spellings, SuperSport, Croatia, Ružarija and profile terms found no personal Forbes profile. No Forbes social is proposed.

The official registry records Velimir Čerkez as SuperSport's original member in 2000 and Ćorić as sole founder or member from May 2001. Croatian reporting nevertheless consistently calls Ćorić the founder. The biography therefore uses the more exact formulation that he took control in 2001 and built the company, while the relationship classification follows the durable public and registry founder terminology.

EMMA did not disclose the price paid for Ćorić's final 33 per cent stake. Entain's later €920 million figure valued SuperSport as a whole and must not be presented as Ćorić's personal proceeds; neither biography does so.

Diversified is the current primary industry because official records show simultaneous, active interests across fund management, hospitality, property, construction, nautical services and renewable power. Gambling remains separately classified as the principal wealth-creation industry and historically defining operating platform.

Investor is the current wealth relationship because Ćorić wholly owns an alternative-investment-fund manager and holds or directs companies across several sectors after fully exiting SuperSport ownership. Founder remains a historically defining origin role but is not reused as the current relationship after the 2022 sale.

Gambling and Online gambling & betting are the minimum useful approved active tags. Renewable energy is omitted because the two documented projects are current but not yet sufficiently central to his durable public identity; Hotel investing is omitted because one material acquisition and a current holding-company registration do not establish a sufficiently defining recurring strategy.

No reliable public evidence established a middle name, secondary nationality or birthplace. Media says Ćorić is from Široki Brijeg, but that wording does not prove place or country of birth and therefore does not justify changing the source birth-country field. The exact birth date comes from a mirrored filed company agreement and is proposed at high rather than very-high confidence.

No qualifying personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube, TikTok or Wikipedia profile was verified. Company and registry pages are evidentiary sources rather than personal social profiles.

Both biographies exclude the selection vessel, company financial snapshots, private addresses, personal identifiers, family property and unsupported net-worth estimates. The short identity card is 51 words; the structurally independent two-paragraph profile is 117 words.
